name: name-forms-dev
description:
How often each form of a Czech or Slovak name is missed: generated texts naming invented
people in every case, after pan/paní, as a surname or first name alone, as a nickname, a
possessive or an English name, plus texts naming nobody (experiments/name_forms.py). Recall
per form, case and declension class follows the standard tables. Development half only.
